note: Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF (Wisdom Ranger District) campground at 7,200 ft, its sites scattered in the trees along the shores of Twin Lakes with views of the Beaverhead Mountains; day-use picnic area, boat launch and fishing access. From Wisdom 7 mi south on MT-278, Twin Lakes Rd 7 mi, then FR 945 5 mi and FR 183 5 mi. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated Aug 31, 2026): confirmed $15/night (+$5 extra vehicle), FCFS, 21 sites, 25-ft trailer limit, vault toilets, potable water; added season mid-June through September and no garbage service.
